name: Life of a Bean
author: bbrunell
description: (Not Finished) Are you loyal to yourself and the task at hand? Find out by playing!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The golden spoon, bowl of beans, and all bean characters were created by me, using Piskel. Background music was also created by me, using BeepBox.  Menu, win, and game over screens were referenced from : https://www.sitepoint.com/adding-pause-main-menu-and-game-over-screens-in-unity/                                                                                                     I also used the Farland Skies - Cloudy Crown and Pixel Art Platformer - Village Props assets.
